title: Analytics event batch
description: POST body of the warehouse ingest (Rocapine/rocalytics-warehouse services/event-ingest, /v1/batch), sent by @rocapine/rocalytics-sdk/analytics. The ingest answers {"outcome":"accepted"} (invalid events inside the batch are dropped one by one) or {"outcome":"rejected"} (the whole batch is unusable); any other answer is transient and the same batch is sent again, so event_id must be unique per event and stable across retries.

app_id.description: Bundle id / package name; must be on the ingest's allowlist

sent_at.description: Device time at send, ms since the epoch; the ingest corrects event times by its gap to the receive time when that exceeds 5 minutes

time.description: Device time of the event, ms since the epoch

user_id.description: The app's own account id (Amplitude setUserId)

session_id.description: Session start, ms since the epoch

user_properties.description: Set on $identify events; at most 32 KB as JSON
